title: A unified approach to the definition of anti-algebras
summary: We introduce the $\mathfrak M$arseille anti-construction $\mathfrak{Ma}$ for varieties of algebras defined by multilinear identities of degree $3$, obtained by changing the sign of the right-nested part of each defining polynomial. This gives, for any variety $\Var$, a new variety $\mathfrak{Ma}$-$\Var$ that generalizes antiassociative algebras and the recently studied anti-Novikov and anti-right-symmetric $\big($pre-Jacobi--Jordan$\big)$ algebras.
